Formula_or_Definition: Arithmetic mean of unweighted per-class F1-scores: (F1_0 + F1_1 + F1_2) / 3
Domain_Interpretation: Measures balanced harmonic mean of precision and recall across all market conditions, weighting minority breakouts equally with Normal stability.
Relevance_to_Mandi_Project: CRITICAL: Prevents models from gaming performance by collapsing to the majority Normal class. Essential for detecting Favorable and Unfavorable breakouts.
Known_Limitations: Treats all three classes with equal weight regardless of sample frequency; sensitive to extreme minority zero-division.
Justification: Directly penalizes failure on minority breakout classes (crucial for Potato and Wheat where Normal dominates).

Formula_or_Definition: Macro-average of recall across all classes: (Recall_0 + Recall_1 + Recall_2) / 3
Domain_Interpretation: Equivalent to overall accuracy if classes were perfectly balanced; random or majority guessing scores exactly 33.33% (1/K).
Relevance_to_Mandi_Project: HIGH: Directly exposes whether a model predicting 85% accuracy is actually learning anything beyond majority-class guessing.
Known_Limitations: Does not incorporate precision; insensitive to false positive rates in individual classes.
Justification: Immediately flags majority-class collapse: Wheat's 85.9% accuracy collapses to 34.1% Balanced Accuracy.

Formula_or_Definition: 3x3 Contingency Table: rows = True Class (0, 1, 2), columns = Predicted Class (0, 1, 2)
Domain_Interpretation: Full empirical audit of all 9 prediction outcomes, distinguishing exact breakout predictions from catastrophic directional flips (predicting Favorable when Unfavorable occurs).
Relevance_to_Mandi_Project: ESSENTIAL: Necessary to audit asymmetrical economic error costs (e.g., False Favorable triggers bad storage losses; False Unfavorable triggers premature selling).
Known_Limitations: Qualitative/tabular artifact; cannot be used directly as a single scalar optimization loss function.
Justification: Only artifact that visualizes off-diagonal directional reversals (predicting Bullish when Market Crashes).

Formula_or_Definition: TP_k / (TP_k + FP_k) for each class k in {Unfavorable, Normal, Favorable}
Domain_Interpretation: Probability that a predicted market advisory condition is accurate. Precision for Favorable measures confidence in holding advice; Precision for Unfavorable measures credibility of distress selling warnings.
Relevance_to_Mandi_Project: HIGH: Farmers need high precision before committing to costly storage fees (₹20/qtl) or rush sales.
Known_Limitations: Can appear artificially high if model rarely predicts a class (very conservative predicting only high-confidence outliers).
Justification: Directly governs storage win rate and farmer trust in specific advisory recommendations.

Formula_or_Definition: TP_k / (TP_k + FN_k) for each class k in {Unfavorable, Normal, Favorable}
Domain_Interpretation: Coverage proportion: what fraction of actual market breakout opportunities or market crashes did the model successfully detect?
Relevance_to_Mandi_Project: HIGH: Measures breakout sensitivity. High recall on Unfavorable prevents farmers from arriving into crashing markets unawares.
Known_Limitations: High recall can be achieved by trivially over-predicting a class, lowering precision.
Justification: Directly exposes minority class blindness (Wheat model achieved only 1.1% recall on Favorable and 3.1% on Unfavorable).

Formula_or_Definition: 2 * (Prec_k * Rec_k) / (Prec_k + Rec_k) for each class k
Domain_Interpretation: Harmonic mean of precision and recall for that specific market condition.
Relevance_to_Mandi_Project: HIGH: Isolates model performance on specific commercial actions (holding produce vs status quo vs distress liquidation).
Known_Limitations: Combines precision and recall with equal weighting, which may not match asymmetrical risk tolerances.
Justification: Permits class-by-class comparison across competing model architectures.

Domain_Interpretation: Proportion of all test observations correctly classified.
Relevance_to_Mandi_Project: LOW TO MODERATE: Historically reported, but highly misleading in mandi data due to modal quote stickiness and majority Normal dominance (~54%-87%).
Known_Limitations: Severely distorted by majority class dominance. A naive model guessing Normal achieves 87.2% on Wheat and 55.6% overall without learning.
Recommended_Role: SUPPORTING METRIC ONLY (Must be reported with Naive Baseline Lift)
Justification: Disqualified as a primary selection metric; reported only alongside naive baseline for historical consistency.

Formula_or_Definition: Sum of class F1-scores weighted by class prevalence: sum(w_k * F1_k)
Domain_Interpretation: Overall harmonic score reflecting dataset class distribution.
Relevance_to_Mandi_Project: MODERATE: Reflects volume-weighted performance, but heavily dampened by the dominant Normal class.
Known_Limitations: Allows poor performance on rare commercial opportunities (Favorable) to be masked by high accuracy on routine steady days.
Justification: Does not penalize failure on rare breakout opportunities sufficiently.

Domain_Interpretation: Measures probabilistic calibration and confidence of predicted class probabilities.
Relevance_to_Mandi_Project: HIGH FOR PROBABILISTIC MODELS: Evaluates whether predicted probabilities reflect true empirical frequencies.
Known_Limitations: Sensitive to extreme overconfidence (probabilities near 0 or 1); requires well-calibrated soft probabilities from tree ensembles.
Justification: Recommended when evaluating probabilistic decision rules (e.g. holding produce only when P(Favorable) >= tau).

Domain_Interpretation: Mean squared error between predicted class probabilities and one-hot true indicators.
Relevance_to_Mandi_Project: MODERATE: Bounded proper scoring rule [0, 2] evaluating probabilistic forecast quality.
Known_Limitations: Less sensitive to extreme probability outliers than log loss; harder to interpret intuitively for non-statisticians.
Justification: Useful in Stage 4 for validating probability calibration curves.

Domain_Interpretation: Point regression errors on future prices or returns.
Relevance_to_Mandi_Project: DISQUALIFIED: Project mandate is 100% pure classification. Previous audit proved regression fails against zero-return persistence benchmarks.
Known_Limitations: Fails to distinguish actionable directional trends from noise; penalized heavily by fat-tailed price shocks.
Justification: The project explicitly rejected point price regression in favor of discrete 3-class market condition classification.
